title: B009 safe fix alters evaluated side effects
body:
Ruff 0.16.8, Python 3.12: ruff check --select B009 --fix changes side effects when rewriting getattr with **kwargs. Reproduction: events=[]; getattr(1,'real',**(events.append('kw') or {})); print(events).
